findings.detail: Own price elasticity estimates differ from 聂森 et al. (2024). 水生根茎类: -1.01 vs -0.03 (聂森). 花叶类: -0.23 vs -1.92 (聂森). This confirms H5 human decision to estimate from own data. Large discrepancies for 水生根茎类 and 花叶类 should be noted in paper.

M2 baseline ARIMA underpredicts 水生根茎类 (13.4 vs Prophet 30.6 kg) — ARIMA misses seasonal recovery. This inflates the M1 vs M2 profit gap (2918 vs 723). The gap is partly driven by better seasonal forecasting (Prophet advantage) and partly by markup optimization.
